title: Mukhtasar Minhaj al-Qasidin
author: shams-al-din-ibn-qudama
attributionNote: The attribution is the one the manuscript tradition and the scholarship give.
description: Shams al-Din Ibn Qudama's abridgement of Ibn al-Jawzi's Minhaj al-Qasidin, itself a reworking of al-Ghazali's Ihya. It covers knowledge, purification, prayer, alms, fasting, pilgrimage, the Qur'an, remembrance, marriage, trade, the duties of the heart and the remembrance of death, in a compact Hanbali recension.
historicalContext: Written in Damascus in the late thirteenth century by a member of the Ibn Qudama family of Hanbali scholars. The abridgement made the ethical programme of the Ihya available in a shorter and more strictly traditional form, and it circulated widely among Hanbali readers.
availabilityNote: Arabic text only, streamed from OpenITI at read time. No English translation is included because no public-domain English translation was verified. Only the catalogue record, chapter outline and passage index are held here.
